title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Electronics Cap on Reconsidered Claims
content:
**Clause.** On a reconsideration of a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim, the electronics value is capped at the reconsideration's electronics cap: the level's electronics sublimit multiplied by 1.5 when the covered unit's class includes an individual door alarm, by 1.25 when the class has no door alarm and no drive-up access, and by 1 otherwise.

The door alarm and drive-up access are features of the unit class of the covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.

**Cases (hypothetical, electronics sublimit 1,600.00).**
1. Class with an individual door alarm, drive-up or not: cap 2,400.00.
2. Class with no door alarm and no drive-up access: cap 2,000.00.
3. Class with drive-up access and no door alarm: cap 1,600.00.
